create_Transition: create a Transition object with action tokens, observation tokens, and reward values for an RL environment step
run_reference_rollout: run a reference rollout that executes an agent against an RL environment with a reward function
create_Trajectory: create a Trajectory object to track transitions, tokens, log probs, and rewards during an RL episode
implement_Env_subclass: implement a subclass of Env with start, step, and max_action_len methods to define a new RL environment
create_RewardFn: create a RewardFn subclass that computes reward sequences from Transition outcomes for an RL environment
